sentences.en: Today, a secretive company promising the next generation of facial recognition software has compiled a database of images far bigger than anything ever constructed by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，一家承诺带来下一代人脸识别软件的神秘公司，建立了一个数据库，其中的图像比美国历史上

sentences.en: government.

sentences.en: The Daily's Annie Brown speaks to reporter Kashmir Hill about whether the technology is a breakthrough for law enforcement or the end of privacy as we know it.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》的安妮·布朗采访了记者克什米尔·希尔，探讨这项技术究竟是执法部门的突破，还是我们所熟知的隐私的终结。

sentences.en: It's Monday, February 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月10日，星期一。

sentences.en: Kashmir, how did this story come to you?
sentences.zh: 克什米尔，你是怎么接触到这个故事的？

sentences.en: So I got an email.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: It was a Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 那是一个星期三的早晨。

sentences.en: I was checking my phone and it was from a tipster who had gotten a bunch of documents from police departments.
sentences.zh: 我正在查看手机，发信人是一个线人，他从警察局弄到了一堆文件。

sentences.en: And one of the police departments sent along this memo about a private company that was offering a radical new tool to solve crimes using facial recognition.
sentences.zh: 其中一个警察局随信发来了一份备忘录，内容是一家私营公司正在提供一种激进的新工具，利用人脸识别来破案。

sentences.en: And what would make a facial recognition tool radical?
sentences.zh: 什么样的事物会让人脸识别工具变得激进？

sentences.en: So law enforcement has for years had access to facial recognition tools.
sentences.zh: 多年来，执法部门一直能够接触到人脸识别工具。

sentences.en: But what this company was offering was unlike any other facial recognition tools that police had been using
sentences.zh: 但这家公司提供的工具与警察们以前使用的任何其他人脸识别工具都不同，

sentences.en: because they had scraped the open web of public photos from Facebook, from Venmo, from Twitter,
sentences.zh: 因为他们从公开网络上抓取了来自Facebook、Venmo、Twitter、

sentences.en: from education sites, employment sites, and had a massive database of billions of photos.
sentences.zh: 教育网站、就业网站的公开照片，拥有了一个包含数十亿张照片的庞大数据库。

sentences.en: So the pitch is that you can take a picture of a criminal suspect, put their face into this app, and identify them in seconds.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的推销说辞是，你可以拍一张犯罪嫌疑人的照片，把他们的脸输入这个应用程序，几秒钟内就能识别出他们的身份。

sentences.en: And when you read this memo, what do you make of what this company is offering?
sentences.zh: 当你读到这份备忘录时，你对这家公司提供的东西有什么看法？

sentences.en: So I've been covering privacy for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我报道隐私问题已经10年了。

sentences.en: And I know that a technology like this in public hands is the nightmare scenario.
sentences.zh: 我知道，落入公众手中的此类技术简直是噩梦般的场景。

sentences.en: This has been a tool that was too taboo for Silicon Valley giants who are capable of building it.
sentences.zh: 对于有能力构建它的硅谷巨头来说，这一直是一个过于禁忌的工具。

sentences.en: Google in 2011 said that they could release a tool like this, but it was the one technology they were holding back because it could be used in a very bad way.
sentences.zh: 谷歌在2011年曾表示，他们本可以发布这样一款工具，但这是他们唯一保留没有推出的技术，因为它可能会被用于非常邪恶的途径。

sentences.en: And why exactly is this kind of technology this line in the sand that no one will cross?
sentences.zh: 为什么这种技术偏偏是这条谁也不能逾越的红线？

sentences.en: What makes it so dangerous?
sentences.zh: 是什么让它如此危险？

sentences.en: So imagine this technology in public hands.
sentences.zh: 试想一下这项技术落入公众手中。

sentences.en: It would mean that if you were at a bar and someone saw you and was interested in you, they could take your photo,
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果你在酒吧里，有人看到你并对你感兴趣，他们就可以拍下你的照片，

sentences.en: run your face to the app, and then it pulls up all these
sentences.zh: 把你的脸输入应用程序，然后它就会调出所有这些

sentences.en: photos of you from the internet.
sentences.zh: 你在网上的照片。

sentences.en: It probably takes them back to your Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 它可能会把你带到你的Facebook主页。

sentences.en: So now they know your name, they know who you're friends with, they can Google your name, they can see where you live, where you work, maybe how much money you make.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们知道了你的名字，知道你的朋友是谁，他们可以谷歌你的名字，可以看到你住在哪里，在哪里工作，甚至可能知道你赚多少钱。

sentences.en: Let's say you're a parent and you're walking down the street with your three-year-old.
sentences.zh: 假设你是一个父母，正带着你三岁的孩子走在街上。

sentences.en: Somebody can take a photo of you and know where the two of you live.
sentences.zh: 有人就可以拍下你的照片，并知道你们两个住在哪里。

sentences.en: Imagine you're a protester in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你是一名在美国

sentences.en: or in a more authoritarian regime.
sentences.zh: 或在某个更专制政体下的抗议者。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, they know everything about you and you can face repercussions for just trying to exercise your political opinions.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他们对你的一切了如指掌，而你可能仅仅因为试图行使你的政治观点而面临打击报复。

sentences.en: You know, if this app were made publicly available, it would be the end of being anonymous in public.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果这个应用程序向公众开放，那将意味着在公共场合再无匿名可言。

sentences.en: You would have to assume anyone can know who you are anytime they're able to take a photo of your face.
sentences.zh: 你必须假设，任何人在能够拍到你脸部的照片时，随时都能知道你是谁。

sentences.en: And so that technology is what this company is pitching these police departments.
sentences.zh: 这就是这家公司向这些警察局推销的技术。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what do you know about this company at this point?
sentences.zh: 此时此刻你对这家公司了解多少？

sentences.en: So at this point, all I really know is that the company is called Clearview AI.
sentences.zh: 所以在此时，我真正知道的全部就是这家公司名叫Clearview AI。

sentences.en: And so the first thing I do is Google it and I find their website, which is clearview.ai.
sentences.zh: 我做的第一件事就是在谷歌上搜索它，找到了他们的网站，即clearview.ai。

sentences.en: And the website is pretty bare, but there's also an office address listed there, 145 West 41st Street, which happens to be just a couple of blocks from the New York Times office.
sentences.zh: 这个网站相当简陋，但上面也列出了一个办公地址：西41街145号，而这个地址恰好距离《纽约时报》办公室只有几个街区。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I decide to, you know, walk over there and there just is no 145 West 41st Street.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定，你知道的，走过去看看，结果根本没有什么西41街145号。

sentences.en: So that was weird.
sentences.zh: 所以这就很诡异了。

sentences.en: So now I have this company that's offering this radical new tool.
sentences.zh: 现在我面对的是这样一家公司，它提供这种激进的新工具，

sentences.en: It's got a fake address.
sentences.zh: 却有一个虚假的地址。

sentences.en: It's got a fake address, which is a, you know, a huge red flag.
sentences.zh: 它有一个假地址，这你知道的，是一个巨大的危险信号。

sentences.en: So what do you do next?
sentences.zh: 那你接下来怎么做？

sentences.zh: 我在LinkedIn上找到了这家公司。

sentences.en: It only had one employee listed, a sales manager named
sentences.zh: 上面只列出了一名员工，一个名叫

sentences.en: It seemed like it could also be fake.
sentences.zh: 这看起来也可能是假的。

sentences.en: And I sent that person a LinkedIn message and never heard back.
sentences.zh: 我给那个人发了一条LinkedIn消息，但从未收到回复。

sentences.en: So one of the things I find online is a website called
sentences.zh: 我在网上发现的一件事是一个名为

sentences.en: Hitchbook that lists investments in startups.
sentences.zh: Hitchbook的网站，上面列出了对初创公司的投资。

sentences.zh: 上面说这家Clearview AI已经获得了

sentences.en: $7 million from a venture capital firm and from Peter Thiel, you know, a big name in Silicon Valley invested in Facebook and Palantir.
sentences.zh: 来自一家风险投资公司以及彼得·蒂尔的700万美元投资，你知道的，他是硅谷的大人物，投资过Facebook和Palantir。

sentences.en: So I reach out to his spokesperson and he says,
sentences.zh: 于是我联系了他的发言人，对方说，

sentences.en: I'll get back to you.
sentences.zh: 我会回复你的。

sentences.en: I never hear from him again.
sentences.zh: 但我再也没有听到他的任何消息。

sentences.en: And then one day I open up Facebook and I have a message from a friend whose name I don't recognize.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天我打开Facebook，看到了一条来自一个我不认识名字的朋友的消息。

sentences.en: And he says, hey, I hear you're looking into Clearview AI.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，我听说你在调查Clearview AI。

sentences.en: You know, I know them.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认识他们。

sentences.zh: 他们是一家伟大的公司。

sentences.en: How can I help?
sentences.zh: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

sentences.en: And you don't know who this guy is?
sentences.zh: 而你不知道这家伙是谁？

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a guy I met once 10 years ago and somehow he knows that I'm looking into this company, but I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个我10年前见过一次的人，不知怎么的，他知道我在调查这家公司，但我接受这一切。

sentences.en: You know, finally someone wants to talk to me about Clearview
sentences.zh: 你知道的，终于有人想跟我谈谈Clearview

sentences.en: AI.
sentences.zh: AI了。

sentences.en: And so I say, hey, can I give you a call?
sentences.zh: 所以我说，嘿，我能给你打个电话吗？

sentences.en: And then he doesn't respond, which I'm getting used to.
sentences.zh: 然后他没有回复，对此我也有点习惯了。

sentences.en: You just can't catch a break.
sentences.zh: 你就是时运不济。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: I'm like, I cannot believe this is another dead end.
sentences.zh: 我想，我简直不敢相信这是又一个死胡同。

sentences.en: So phone and email are not working for me.
sentences.zh: 所以电话和电子邮件对我都不起作用。

sentences.en: So I just need to figure out another door to knock on to try to talk to a real human being.
sentences.zh: 我只需要想出另一扇可以敲响的门，试图去和一个真正的活人对话。

sentences.en: And one of the investors in the company is this venture capital firm that has an office in Bronxville, New York.
sentences.zh: 这家公司的投资者之一是一家在纽约布朗克斯维尔设有办公室的风险投资公司。

sentences.en: So on a cold, rainy Tuesday, I got on the train and headed to Bronxville.
sentences.zh: 于是在一个寒冷多雨的星期二，我上了火车，前往布朗克斯维尔。

sentences.en: I get to the company's address.
sentences.zh: 我到了这家公司的地址。

sentences.en: It's just like in a retail space and go inside.
sentences.zh: 它就像在一个零售空间里，我走了进去。

sentences.en: There's this long, quiet hallway of office suites.
sentences.zh: 这里是一条长而安静的办公套间走廊。

sentences.en: And this venture capital firm is at the very end.
sentences.zh: 这家风险投资公司就在最尽头。

sentences.en: And I knock on the door and there's no one there.
sentences.zh: 我敲了敲门，里面没有人。

sentences.en: So I start trying to talk to their neighbors.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始试着和他们的邻居交谈。

sentences.en: And a woman who works next door says, oh, yeah, they're never here.
sentences.zh: 隔壁的一位女士说，哦，对，他们从来不在办公室。

sentences.en: So I'm walking down the stairs to go back out of the building.
sentences.zh: 所以我正沿着楼梯走下去，打算离开这栋大楼。

sentences.en: And two guys walk through the door.
sentences.zh: 这时有两个家伙从门外走了进来。

sentences.en: They're both in dark suits with like lavender and pink shirts underneath.
sentences.zh: 他们都穿着深色西装，里面好像穿着薰衣草色和粉红色的衬衫。

sentences.en: And they just kind of look like VCs to me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来他们长得很像风险投资家。

sentences.en: So I say, hey, are you with this venture capital firm?
sentences.zh: 所以我说，嘿，你们是这家风险投资公司的人吗？

sentences.en: And they say, we are.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们是。

sentences.en: Who are you?
sentences.zh: 你又是谁？

sentences.en: And I was like, I'm the New York Times reporter who's been trying to get in touch with you.
sentences.zh: 我说，我是那个一直在试图联系你们的《纽约时报》记者。

sentences.en: And they said, you know, the company has told us not to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道的，公司已经告诉过我们不要跟你讲话。

sentences.en: And I said, well,
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，

sentences.en: I've come all the way out to Bronxville.
sentences.zh: 我都一路大老远来到布朗克斯维尔了。

sentences.en: You know, can we just chat for a little bit?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们能稍微聊一会儿吗？

sentences.en: And they say, OK, it probably helps.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，这大概有帮助吧。

sentences.en: I'm like very pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我挺着个大肚子。

sentences.en: And they offered me water.
sentences.zh: 他们给我倒了水。

sentences.en: And they just start telling me everything.
sentences.zh: 然后他们开始把什么都告诉我。

sentences.en: And what do they tell you?
sentences.zh: 他们都对你说了些什么？

sentences.en: They confirm that they've invested in Clearview AI and that Peter Thiel has also invested.
sentences.zh: 他们证实他们确实投资了Clearview AI，并且彼得·蒂尔也进行了投资。

sentences.en: They identified the genius coder behind the company, this guy named Juan Thontat.
sentences.zh: 他们说出了这家公司背后的天才程序员，一个名叫阮通塔的家伙。

sentences.en: And they say he's Vietnamese royalty, but he's from Australia.
sentences.zh: 他们说他是越南皇室后裔，但来自澳大利亚。

sentences.en: And they also tell me that Juan is the one that was using the fake name John Good on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 他们还告诉我，阮就是那个在LinkedIn上使用假名约翰·古德的人。

sentences.en: He's John Good.
sentences.zh: 他就是约翰·古德。

sentences.en: He's John Good.
sentences.zh: 他就是约翰·古德。

sentences.en: And they confirmed that law enforcement is already using the app and that law enforcement loves it and that it's spreading like wildfire.
sentences.zh: 他们证实，执法部门已经在开始使用这款应用了，执法部门非常喜欢它，而且它正在像野火一样蔓延。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So I've learned some stuff from these two investors, but no one from the company is talking to me still.
sentences.zh: 所以我从这两个投资人那里了解了一些情况，但公司里仍然没有人跟我说话。

sentences.en: So in the meantime, I am also reaching out to law enforcement because I want to know if this
sentences.zh: 所以在同时，我也在联系执法部门，因为我想知道这款

sentences.zh: 应用是否真的像公司声称的那样好用。到这个时候，我已经了解到有超过600个执法

sentences.en: enforcement agencies had tried the app, including the Department of Homeland Security and the FBI.
sentences.zh: 机构尝试过这款应用，其中包括国土安全部和联邦调查局。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It's not just local police departments.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是地方警察局的事。

sentences.en: This is being used by the federal government already.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府已经在使用了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I was just shocked to discover how easily government agencies can just try a new technology without apparently knowing much about the company that provides it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我震惊地发现，政府机构竟然能如此轻易地去尝试一项新技术，而对提供该公司的背景却似乎知之甚少。

sentences.en: So I talked to a retired police chief from Indiana who was actually one of the first departments to use the app.

sentences.en: And they solved a case within 20 seconds, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们在20秒内就破获了一个案件。

sentences.en: A case they hadn't been able to solve.
sentences.zh: 一个他们一直无法破解的案件。

sentences.en: That they hadn't been able to solve.
sentences.zh: 他们以前一直无法破解的案件。

sentences.zh: 其中一位警官告诉我，他重新翻查了大约30起没有在政府数据库中匹配到任何结果的悬案。

sentences.en: And he got a bunch of hits using the app.
sentences.zh: 然后他用这款应用匹配出了大量结果。

sentences.en: So they were really excited about it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对此真的感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: This is way more effective than what they were using before.
sentences.zh: 这比他们以前使用的工具要有效得多。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 但后来他们把他的脸输入了 Clearview 的应用，结果他在别人的健身房自拍照的背景里出现了。

sentences.en: Like you could see his face in the mirror.

sentences.en: We have to protect our members' privacy.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保护会员的隐私。

sentences.en: But then later, the detectives got a text from somebody who worked there identifying the person.
sentences.zh: 但后来，侦探们收到了一条在那里工作的人发来的短信，认出了这个人。

sentences.en: And that, I mean, that's just something that would not have been possible without Clearview's app.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果没有 Clearview 的应用，这是绝对不可能做到的。

sentences.en: So because officers were telling me the tool works so well, I wanted to see it for myself, on myself.
sentences.zh: 所以因为警员们一直告诉我这个工具多么好用，我想亲自在自己身上试一试。

sentences.zh: 于是我问他们能不能把我的照片输入应用查一下。

sentences.zh: 每次我这么做，事情就会变得诡异起来。

sentences.zh: 没有我的照片，这真的很奇怪，因为网上有很多我的照片。

sentences.en: And then officers would just stop responding to me or talking to me.

sentences.en: And I had no idea what was going on until one officer was kind enough to explain to me.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道发生了什么，直到有一个警员好心向我解释。

sentences.zh: 我没有公开这位警员的姓名，因为他因为跟我如此坦诚地谈论 Clearview 可能会惹上大麻烦。

sentences.en: If you could just describe yourself to the extent that you can describe yourself.
sentences.zh: 如果你能尽量描述一下你自己的话。

sentences.zh: 我是一家大型大都市警察局的警官。

sentences.zh: 所以他是一个正在对该应用进行 30 天免费试用的警察。

sentences.en: And he was really impressed with it.
sentences.zh: 他对这个应用印象非常深刻。

sentences.en: So I asked him if he wouldn't mind running my photo.
sentences.zh: 所以我问他介不介意帮我查一下照片。

sentences.en: And what did he tell you happened when he sent your picture through?
sentences.zh: 他跟你说了把你的照片传进去后发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, nothing.
sentences.zh: 对，什么都没有。

sentences.en: I didn't get a response at all.
sentences.zh: 我根本没有收到回复。

sentences.en: No results.
sentences.zh: 没有结果。

sentences.en: No results.
sentences.zh: 没有结果。

sentences.en: And within a couple of minutes of me putting your photo up there, maybe five, less than 10, I got a phone call from the Clearview company.
sentences.zh: 在我把你的照片上传上去几分钟内，大概五分钟，不到十分钟，我就接到了 Clearview 公司的电话。

sentences.en: They wanted to know why I was uploading a New York Times reporter's photo.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道我为什么要上传一个《纽约时报》记者的照片。

sentences.en: That is so wild.
sentences.zh: 这太离谱了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.zh: 作为一名记者，这让我感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.zh: 所以这意味着 Clearview 在他们的系统中给我的脸作了标记，当一个

sentences.zh: 警察搜索我的脸时，他们就会收到警报，我觉得，你知道的，这非常令人担忧，因为这第一次

sentences.en: first time that this company is able to monitor who law enforcement is looking for and not just know who they're looking for, but manipulate the results.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，这家公司能够监控执法人员在寻找谁，不仅知道他们在找谁，还能操控搜索结果。

sentences.en: And so then that made me go back to the earlier officers who had run my photo.
sentences.zh: 所以这让我去找了之前帮我查过照片的那些警员。

sentences.en: And they all confirmed, yes, I got a call from the company and they said, you know, we're not supposed to be talking to the media.
sentences.zh: 他们都证实了，没错，我接到了公司的电话，他们说，你知道的，我们不应该和媒体交谈。

sentences.en: So were you able to keep using the app after that?
sentences.zh: 那之后你还能继续使用这个应用吗？

sentences.zh: 我的账号被停用了。

sentences.en: Did you ever get access back?
sentences.zh: 你后来恢复权限了吗？

sentences.zh: 我从来没有恢复过。

sentences.en: But, you know, I have colleagues that have access.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我有同事还有权限。

sentences.en: So if I were to need a picture searched, I could just email it to them and they could email me the results.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我有需要搜索的照片，我可以发电子邮件给他们，他们可以把结果发邮件给我。

sentences.en: And you think the trade-offs are worth it in terms of, you know, what the company has access to?
sentences.zh: 你觉得从公司所掌握的信息来看，这些代价是值得的吗？

sentences.en: Do I think it's worth it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得值得吗？

sentences.en: So from a law enforcement perspective, it's worth it.
sentences.zh: 所以从执法部门的角度来看，这是值得的。

sentences.en: You know, we get a lot of cases and we don't usually have a lot of leads.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有很多案子，而且通常没有很多线索。

sentences.en: And so anything that can, honestly, anything that can help us solve a crime is a win for us.
sentences.zh: 所以任何能，老实说，任何能帮我们破案的东西对我们来说都是一次胜利。

sentences.en: From a privacy perspective, it's rather frightening.
sentences.zh: 从隐私的角度来看，这相当可怕。

sentences.en: The amount of information that they were able to get and provide.
sentences.zh: 他们能够获取并提供的信息量。

sentences.en: As long as they're doing it for the right reasons, everything will work out.
sentences.zh: 只要他们是为了正确的目的这样做，一切都会顺利的。

sentences.en: Let's put it that way.
sentences.zh: 我们这么说吧。

sentences.zh: 但问题是，目前我们对这家公司一无所知。

sentences.en: We don't know if there's any kind of oversight.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道是否存在任何形式的监督。

sentences.en: We don't know who the people are that are operating this and what their intentions are with their product.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道运营这个产品的人是谁，他们对自己的产品抱有什么意图。

sentences.en: You know, the person in charge of the company won't talk to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，负责这家公司的人不跟我谈。

sentences.zh: 但到了 12 月底，我接到了公司女发言人的电话。

sentences.zh: 她说创始人阮坦达（Juan Tan Tat）准备好接受采访了。

sentences.zh: 哦，我有很多问题，所以我会占用你给我的所有时间。

sentences.en: So, Kashmir, you finally got an interview with the founder of Clearview, this man named Juan Tan Tat.
sentences.zh: 那么，卡什米尔，你终于采访到了 Clearview 的创始人，这个名叫阮坦达的人。

sentences.zh: 你在哪里见他的？

sentences.en: So we met in a WeWork in Chelsea.
sentences.zh: 我们在切尔西的一家 WeWork 见面的。

sentences.zh: 他下楼到了大厅。

sentences.en: You're going to stay here?
sentences.zh: 你要留在这里吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.zh: 他的外表让我感到惊讶，因为我在网上搜过他，有很多他的照片。

sentences.en: And he's usually pretty eccentric, like a lot of paisley shirts.
sentences.zh: 他通常挺特立独行的，喜欢穿很多佩斯利花纹衬衫。

sentences.zh: 他是火人节的常客。

sentences.zh: 但现实中，他非常保守。

sentences.zh: 他穿着一件深海军蓝西装，内搭白色扣领衬衫，脚穿皮鞋。

sentences.en: So he looked very much like the security startup entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 所以他看起来非常像那种安全领域的初创公司企业家。

sentences.zh: 他看起来很符合这个身份？

sentences.zh: 他看起来很符合这个身份。

sentences.zh: 你是什么时候出生的？

sentences.zh: 对，那你对技术是怎么产生兴趣的？

sentences.zh: 我四五岁的时候，家里当然就有一台电脑。

sentences.zh: 然后你就可以在网上发现所有这些东西。

sentences.zh: 但是对于 Linux，我当时就觉得，我必须得到这个东西。

sentences.zh: 这是有史以来最书呆子的事情。

sentences.zh: 他最近的应用之一叫做“特朗普发型”，这是一个把特朗普的发型加到你的照片里的应用。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.zh: 那你怎么从一个唐纳德·特朗普发型应用，过渡到一个似乎能彻底变革警察工作的工具呢？

sentences.en: Well, he moved to New York, and that seemed to be a big change for him, and he started meeting very different people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他搬到了纽约，这对他来说似乎是一个巨大的改变，他开始结识非常不同的人。

sentences.zh: 他遇到的最重要的人之一就是理查德·施瓦茨（Richard Schwartz）。

sentences.zh: 他们俩为什么会选择那个？

sentences.en: But there's a lot of face recognition algorithms out there and a lot that work pretty well.
sentences.zh: 但市面上有很多面部识别算法，其中很多效果都相当不错。

sentences.en: What was different about what Juan Tantat and Richard Schwartz were doing is they had been willing to scrape all of these photos from the Internet.
sentences.zh: 胡安·坦塔特（Juan Tantat）和理查德·施瓦茨（Richard Schwartz）的做法与众不同之处在于，他们愿意从互联网上抓取所有这些照片。

sentences.en: So they just had a huge database of photos.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只是拥有了一个庞大的照片数据库。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Billions of photos.
sentences.zh: 数十亿张照片。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And then we hit this point where we got to like 99% accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然后我们达到了一个节点，准确率达到了99%左右。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个。

sentences.en: We were just in the office.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就在办公室里。

sentences.en: We were just like, wow, it works.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就觉得，哇，真的管用。

sentences.en: Try that one again.
sentences.zh: 再试一张那个。

sentences.en: Try that one again.
sentences.zh: 再试一张那个。

sentences.en: And just every time I would pick the right person up.
sentences.zh: 每次我都能准确挑出正确的人。

sentences.en: And that's when we knew this is crazy.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我们意识到这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: This actually works.
sentences.zh: 这居然真的行得通。

sentences.en: Is that legal?
sentences.zh: 这合法吗？

sentences.en: Can you just take photographs from anywhere on the Internet and use them for this kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 你可以随便从互联网上任何地方拿照片来做这种事吗？

sentences.en: There was a ruling in a federal court this fall that said, yeah, this kind of public scraping seems to be legal.
sentences.zh: 今年秋天联邦法院做出了一项裁决，称这种公开抓取似乎是合法的。

sentences.en: And what are they hoping to do with this software at this point?
sentences.zh: 他们此时希望用这款软件做什么？

sentences.en: I mean, they're just trying to figure out how they can make money off of the app.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们只是在琢磨如何通过这款应用赚钱。

sentences.en: And so they eventually end up settling on law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 所以他们最终决定瞄准执法部门。

sentences.en: And they started solving cases from grainy ATM photos, cases they would have never solved.
sentences.zh: 他们开始从像素模糊的自动取款机照片中破案，这些案件原本是永远无法破获的。

sentences.en: So this kind of spread to different departments and then from one agency to other agencies.
sentences.zh: 因此，这传到了不同的部门，然后从一个机构传到了其他机构。

sentences.en: And do you ask him about that thing that happened with the officer who couldn't find your photos?
sentences.zh: 你有没有问他关于那个警官找不到你照片的插曲？

sentences.en: Yeah, so that was one of my questions.
sentences.zh: 对，那其实是我的问题之一。

sentences.en: And I wasn't entirely satisfied by his answer.
sentences.zh: 而且我对他的回答并不是完全满意。

sentences.en: One thing that surprised me, some of the officers I talked to tried to run my photos through it.
sentences.zh: 让我惊讶的一点是，我交谈过的一些警官尝试用它来搜我的照片。

sentences.en: And they got no hits.
sentences.zh: 结果什么都没搜到。

sentences.en: And I have like tons of photos online.
sentences.zh: 而我在网上有海量的照片。

sentences.en: It must have been a bug.
sentences.zh: 那一定是个漏洞。

sentences.en: Did you guys block me from like getting results?
sentences.zh: 你们是不是把我屏蔽了，导致搜不出结果？

sentences.en: I don't know about that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这事。

sentences.en: Because I was like, this doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这根本说不通。

sentences.en: He said, oh, yeah, that was a software bug.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，对，那是个软件漏洞。

sentences.en: But he laughed.
sentences.zh: 但他笑了。

sentences.en: I was like, I have a thousand photos online.
sentences.zh: 我想：我在网上有一千张照片。

sentences.en: This can't work as well as they say it works.
sentences.zh: 这不可能像他们说的那样好用。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, it must have been a bug in the software.
sentences.zh: 对，好吧，那肯定是软件里的一个漏洞。

sentences.en: Why did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: It totally made me think that.
sentences.zh: 这完全让我产生了这种想法。

sentences.en: Maybe it doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 也许它根本不管用。

sentences.en: You never know, right?
sentences.zh: 你永远说不准，对吧？

sentences.en: This could be the long con.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一场漫长的骗局。

sentences.en: I'm kidding.
sentences.zh: 我开玩笑的。

sentences.en: I'm kidding.
sentences.zh: 我开玩笑的。

sentences.en: It works.
sentences.zh: 它确实管用。

sentences.en: What do you think that was about?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I don't think it was a software bug.
sentences.zh: 我不认为那是什么软件漏洞。

sentences.en: It's about it.
sentences.zh: 就是那么回事。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: You have no idea, huh?
sentences.zh: 你一点头绪都没有，是吧？

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So he said the software bug is now fixed.
sentences.zh: 所以他说软件漏洞现在已经修复了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: So I'll show you.
sentences.zh: 那我给你看。

sentences.en: This is the iPhone version.
sentences.zh: 这是iPhone版本。

sentences.en: And he took a photo of me.
sentences.zh: 然后他拍了张我的照片。

sentences.en: Oh, it does work.
sentences.zh: 哦，它确实管用。

sentences.en: Oh, that's so surprising.
sentences.zh: 哦，太令人惊讶了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And there, the results included a bunch of photos of me online.
sentences.zh: 结果里赫然出现了一堆我在网上的照片。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I totally forgot.
sentences.zh: 我都完全忘了。

sentences.en: That was 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是10年前的事了。

sentences.en: Including some I had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 甚至包括一些我从未见过照片。

sentences.en: I didn't know her online.
sentences.zh: 我根本不认识网上的她。

sentences.en: So he's just brushing off this weird thing that happened to you.
sentences.zh: 所以他只是轻描淡写地敷衍了发生在你身上的这件怪事。

sentences.en: But do you get the sense that he's thinking at all about privacy?
sentences.zh: 但你有没有感觉到他其实压根没在考虑隐私问题？

sentences.en: So I asked him, you know, this is a very powerful app.
sentences.zh: 所以我问他，你知道的，这是一个非常强大的应用。

sentences.en: And I asked him, what restrictions is he thinking about for it?
sentences.zh: 我问他对它有什么限制考虑？

sentences.en: And he said, you know, one, that they were only selling it to law enforcement right now.
sentences.zh: 他说，第一，他们目前只把产品卖给执法部门。

sentences.en: Though it does turn out that they're also selling it to a few private companies for security purposes.
sentences.zh: 不过事实证明，他们也出于安全目的将其出售给了一些私人公司。

sentences.en: But he said they wouldn't sell it to bad actors or bad governments.
sentences.zh: 但他表示他们不会把它卖给不良分子或不良政府。

sentences.en: And our philosophy is basically, if it's a U.S.-based, both like a democracy or an ally of the U.S., we will consider it.
sentences.zh: 我们的理念基本上是，如果是基于美国的，无论是民主国家还是美国的盟友，我们都会考虑。

sentences.en: But like, no China, no Russia or anything that wouldn't, you know, be good.
sentences.zh: 但是，比如不卖给中国、俄罗斯或任何你知道的、不好的国家。

sentences.en: So if it's a country where it's just governed terribly or whatever, I don't know if we'd feel comfortable, you know, selling to certain countries.
sentences.zh: 所以如果是一个治理得一塌糊涂之类的国家，我不知道把产品卖给某些国家我们是否会感到安心。

sentences.en: So it doesn't sound like he has much of a rubric for deciding who to sell to.
sentences.zh: 听起来他对决定把产品卖给谁并没有什么明确的标准。

sentences.en: And it sounds like there's no one really overseeing how he's making these decisions.
sentences.zh: 听起来也没有人在真正监督他是如何做出这些决定的。

sentences.en: At this point, it's just up to Clearview to decide who they want to sell the app to.
sentences.zh: 到了这个地步，完全由Clearview自己决定想把这款应用卖给谁。

sentences.en: Not pressure, but like when we talk to some venture capitalists, they're like, why don't you make this consumer?
sentences.zh: 不是施压，但当我们和一些风险投资家交谈时，他们会说，你们为什么不把它推向消费端呢？

sentences.en: You know, law enforcement is such a small market.
sentences.zh: 要知道，执法市场太小了。

sentences.en: You won't make that much money.
sentences.zh: 你们赚不到多少钱。

sentences.en: And we've considered it.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑过。

sentences.en: And we're just like, what's the use case here?
sentences.zh: 但我们就在想，这里的应用场景到底是什么？

sentences.en: And there are, you know, right now we can help catch pedophiles.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道，现在我们可以帮助抓获恋童癖者。

sentences.en: What if a pedophile got access to this, goes around the street?
sentences.zh: 如果一个恋童癖者也用上了这个，在大街上闲逛会怎么样？

sentences.en: But when I was talking to one of their investors, he says, you know, we want to dominate the law enforcement market.
sentences.zh: 但当我与他们的一个投资人交谈时，他说，我们想统治执法市场。

sentences.en: And then we want to move into other markets like hospitality, like real estate.
sentences.zh: 然后我们想进军其他市场，比如酒店业、房地产行业。

sentences.en: And he predicted that one day, you know, all consumers will have access to this app.
sentences.zh: 他预测总有一天，所有的消费者都会用上这款应用。

sentences.en: I can tell you that one of your investors hopes that you guys are going to go into the consumer market.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，你们的一位投资人希望你们进军消费市场。

sentences.en: Yeah, he talks too much.
sentences.zh: 对，他话太多了。

sentences.en: But like, we're not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我们不会那么做。

sentences.en: I just don't.
sentences.zh: 我就是不干。

sentences.en: Juan seems to be saying, yeah, there's pressure on us to sell to private consumers, but we're not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 胡安似乎在说，是的，我们面临着将产品卖给普通消费者的压力，但我们不会这么做。

sentences.en: And how reasonable is it to think that he has control or the company has control at this point over where this technology goes?
sentences.zh: 他或公司在现阶段对这项技术的去向有多大程度的掌控，这种想法究竟有多合理？

sentences.en: I mean, one point that I made when I was talking to him is that oftentimes the tools that law enforcement use end up in the hands of the public.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我和他交谈时提出的一个观点是，执法部门使用的工具往往最终会落入公众手中。

sentences.en: I just, I personally feel like you guys have kind of opened the door to now this becoming more normalized.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我个人觉得你们实际上已经打开了一扇大门，让这种情况变得越来越常态化。

sentences.en: Just because a lot of tools that law enforcement have eventually make their way into the public hands.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为执法部门拥有的许多工具最终都流入了公众手中。

sentences.en: Not always.
sentences.zh: 并不总是这样。

sentences.en: Everyone has a gun.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一把枪。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Anyone who wants one can get one in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国，任何想要枪的人基本上都能搞到一把。

sentences.en: basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上。

sentences.en: His response was strange.
sentences.zh: 他的反应很奇怪。

sentences.en: He said, well, look at guns.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，看看枪支。

sentences.en: Law enforcement has guns, but not everybody has a gun.
sentences.zh: 执法部门有枪，但并不是每个人都有枪。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that's because he's from Australia.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否因为他是澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's proving your point.
sentences.zh: 对，他反倒是在证明你的观点。

sentences.en: It did seem like he was proving my point rather than rebutting it.
sentences.zh: 这看起来确实像是在证明我的观点，而不是反驳它。

sentences.en: You know, we've been building the technology to make this possible for years now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，多年来我们一直在构建让这一切成为可能的技术。

sentences.en: Facebook building this huge database of our photos with our names attached to it.
sentences.zh: Facebook构建了这样一个庞大的照片数据库，上面还附上了我们的名字。

sentences.en: Advances in image recognition and search technologies.
sentences.zh: 图像识别和搜索技术的进步。

sentences.en: It all led us here.
sentences.zh: 这一切把我们带到了这里。

sentences.en: But there's been no accompanying regulation or rules around how the technology should be used.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何配套的法规或规则来规范这项技术应如何使用。

sentences.en: There's no real law or regulation that makes this illegal.
sentences.zh: 没有任何真正的法律或法规规定这是非法的。

sentences.en: The scraping seems to be okay.
sentences.zh: 网络抓取似乎是没问题的。

sentences.en: We don't have a big ban on face recognition.
sentences.zh: 我们没有对人脸识别实施全面的禁令。

sentences.en: We don't need to give consent for people to process our faces.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要同意别人处理我们的脸。

sentences.en: And so, in terms of holding this tool back, we're just relying on the moral compasses of the companies that are making this technology.
sentences.zh: 因此，在遏制这个工具方面，我们只能依靠制造这项技术的人公司的道德罗盘。

sentences.en: And on the thoughtfulness of people like Quantantat.
sentences.zh: 以及像昆坦塔特这样的人的深思熟虑。

sentences.en: But what do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 但你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Do you think that this is kind of too dangerous a tool for everybody to have?
sentences.zh: 你认为对所有人来说，这是一种过于危险的工具吗？

sentences.en: Think about that.
sentences.zh: 考虑一下这个问题。

sentences.en: I'm going to get back to you on an answer because it's a good question.
sentences.zh: 我回头再给你答复，因为这是个好问题。

sentences.en: I mean, I've thought about it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我稍微考虑过。

sentences.en: You haven't thought about it?
sentences.zh: 你没想过吗？

sentences.en: I have, I have.
sentences.zh: 我想过，我想过。

sentences.en: But I need to really, you know, come up with a good answer for that.
sentences.zh: 但我真的需要，你知道的，想出一个好的答案。

sentences.en: Like, honestly, like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 老实说，是的。

sentences.en: Thanks, Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，克什米尔。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Since Kashmir began reporting on Clearview AI, several major social media companies, including Facebook, Twitter, and Venmo,
sentences.zh: 自从克什米尔开始报道Clearview AI以来，包括Facebook、Twitter和Venmo在内的几家主要社交媒体公司

sentences.en: have demanded that the company stop using photos scraped from their websites.
sentences.zh: 已经要求该公司停止使用从其网站上抓取的照片。

sentences.en: But it's unclear what, if any, power those social media companies have to force Clearview to comply.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不清楚这些社交媒体公司有多大权力（如果有的话）强迫Clearview遵守规定。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, the state of New Jersey barred law enforcement from using Clearview's technology.
sentences.zh: 几周前，新泽西州禁止执法部门使用Clearview的技术。

sentences.en: But police remain free to do so in 49 other states.
sentences.zh: 但其他49个州的警察仍然可以自由使用。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: President Trump has begun a campaign of retribution against witnesses in the impeachment inquiry,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已经对弹劾调查中的证人展开了一场报复行动，

sentences.en: firing Gordon Sondland, his ambassador to the European Union, who called the president's actions toward Ukraine a quid pro quo,
sentences.zh: 解雇了戈登·桑德兰（Gordon Sondland），即他驻欧盟的大使，此人曾称总统对乌克兰的行动是利益交换；

sentences.en: and Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Vindman, a member of the National Security Council who expressed alarm over the president's phone call with the leader of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 还有国家安全委员会成员、曾对总统与乌克兰领导人的通话表示惊慌的中校亚历山大·维因德曼（Alexander Vindman）。

sentences.en: The Times reports that several Republican senators urged Trump not to fire the witnesses, fearing it would send a dangerous message, but that the president ignored their advice.
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，几位共和党参议员敦促特朗普不要解雇这些证人，担心这会发出危险的信号，但总统忽略了他们的建议。

sentences.en: And the global death toll from the coronavirus has reached more than 800, surpassing that of the SARS epidemic, which killed 700 at 74 in 2003.
sentences.zh: 新冠肺炎导致的全球死亡人数已超过800人，超过了2003年导致74人（注：此处原文700 at 74为口误或电台播报瑕疵，译文按常规播报处理）死亡的非典疫情。

sentences.en: The number of confirmed infections from the coronavirus now stands at more than 37,000.
sentences.zh: 新冠肺炎的确诊感染人数目前已超过37,000人。

sentences.en: Finally, new polling in New Hampshire, which will hold its primary tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 最后，新罕布什尔州明即将举行初选，最新的民意调查显示，

sentences.en: shows Mayor Pete Buttigieg neck and neck with Senator Bernie Sanders and former Vice President Joe Biden slipping into fourth place.
sentences.zh: 市长皮特·布蒂吉格与参议员伯尼·桑德斯不相上下，而前副总统乔·拜登则滑落至第四位。

sentences.en: Vice President Biden, the first question is for you.
sentences.zh: 拜登副总统，第一个问题提问您。

sentences.en: In the last few days, you've been saying that Democrats would be taking too big a risk if they nominate Senator Sanders or Mayor Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，您一直在说，如果民主党人提名桑德斯参议员或布蒂吉格市长，将会冒太大的风险。

sentences.en: But they came out on top in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 但他们在爱荷华州拔得头筹。

sentences.en: What risks did the Iowa Democrats miss?
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州的民主党人忽视了什么风险？

sentences.en: The poll, conducted by the Boston Globe, WBC and Suffolk University, suggests Buttigieg is benefiting from a strong performance in the Iowa caucuses,
sentences.zh: 这项由《波士顿环球报》、WBC和萨福克大学联合进行的民调显示，布蒂吉格正受益于在爱荷华州党团会议上的强劲表现，

sentences.en: and that Biden may perform poorly for the second time in a row.
sentences.zh: 而拜登可能会连续第二次表现不佳。

sentences.en: A prediction Biden confirmed during Friday night's debate on ABC.
sentences.zh: 这一预测得到了拜登在周五晚间ABC辩论中的证实。

sentences.en: Well, they didn't miss anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们什么也没错过。

sentences.en: I missed the long race.
sentences.zh: 我错过了这场漫长的竞赛。

sentences.en: I took a hit in Iowa, and I'll probably take a hit here traditionally.
sentences.zh: 我在爱荷华州受挫了，而且在这里我传统上可能也会受挫。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感吗，需要绝对黑暗才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方找到《Wirecutter秀》。
